name: EAGLE-2 acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks (MT-bench, HumanEval, GSM8K, Alpaca, CNN/DM, Natural Questions). Average acceptance length τ = 4.65 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 4.04x mean across tasks.
notes: EAGLE-2 with dynamic draft tree, depth 6, 10 nodes expanded per layer, 50 total draft tokens. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding (1.00x). Per-task speedups: MT-bench 4.26x, HumanEval 4.96x, GSM8K 4.22x, Alpaca 4.25x, CNN/DM 3.40x, Natural Questions 3.13x.
